calls.summary: The team convened to address the need for updating and expanding targeting documentation, which was identified as outdated and incomplete by Bryce Fitzsimons. Key topics included the clarification of advanced rules, real-world use cases, and the importance of user attributes in targeting setups as emphasized by Ryan Feigenbaum. Additionally, Teresa Yung raised concerns about mobile teams facing delays due to targeting misconfigurations, prompting discussions on enhancing debugging tools. The complexity of targeting logic was analyzed, with a proposal to segment documentation by user persona to improve usability. The team also initiated plans for a webinar to educate users on advanced feature flag topics, aiming to foster engagement and knowledge sharing. A phased approach for documentation ownership and improvement was established, ensuring collective responsibility across the organization.
calls.keywords: targeting, saved groups, feature flags, SDK attributes, debugging, documentation
